text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part IV · Suits Relating to Decrees and Instruments
 Section: 60::Three years.
]


To set aside a transfer of property made by the guardian of a ward—
(a)by the ward who has attained majority;
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the ward attains majority.
(b)by the ward’s legal representative—
(i)when the ward dies within three years from the date of attaining majority.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the ward attains majority.
(ii)when the ward dies before attaining majority.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the ward dies.
